svg.title: Drilling operator — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as drilling operator, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A long spiral drill descends from a compact drill head into a separated ground line. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
